{{Top|leg}}
'''ZIMM''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|war robot]], who was worshiped by the [[Unidentified Yaled IV cyborgs|cyborgs]] of [[Yaled IV]]. According to ZIMM's sacred [[punch-card]]s, the robot connected itself to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] via a [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|mind probe]], and then transferred the Despot's memories into his [[Verbobrain/Legends|Verbobrain]].<ref name="Despotica Part I">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>
